Every active, identified company member with Sign access can Show or Copy a production key in Settings: https://sign.tvarka.pro/sign/app/settings/#api-keys. Existing integrations and sandbox keys remain supported. Deliberate revocations are not silently undone. Rotation allows at most 24 hours of overlap. See https://sign-api.tvarka.pro/docs#keys.
